items.html: Also it is known that the breasts (dadim) are also called shadayim, as stated 'between his breasts (shadayim) he shall rest' (Genesis 49:25). And the matter — know that there is Shaddai with a soft (rafa) Dalet, and they are in the breasts. And there is Shaddai with a dagesh, and it is a holy Name, and it is below, in the Yesod.
